headline: DeepSeek hits 17.2% — day 2 of dominance
summary: DeepSeek's v4.1-flash just set an all-time token-share record at 17.2%, extending its streak atop the leaderboard. Zhipu AI's glm-5.3-flash vaulted to rank 2 with 15.1% share, also a new high. The top two providers now command 48.5% of the market between them, while OpenAI tumbled 16.2 percentage points week-over-week and Anthropic shed 1.3 points in a single day.
highlights: DeepSeek v4.1-flash: 17.2% share, day 2 of all-time record streak
Zhipu AI glm-5.3-flash: 15.1% share, new all-time high, jumped from rank 3 to rank 2
Top 2 providers (DeepSeek + Zhipu AI): 48.5% combined share
OpenAI down 16.2 points week-over-week; Anthropic dropped 1.3 points in one day
typesafe's jev-1.13 debuts at rank 21 with 0.9% share; Mistral AI's mistral-nemo enters at rank 45
